description: "One Year Abroad" by Blanche Willis Howard is a travel narrative written in the late 19th century. This work captures the essence of various European cities and landscapes, through the eyes of a reflective traveler who shares her observations and experiences journeying from Hamburg to Heidelberg and beyond.
